projects.overview: Sample calculation fixture for a custom website engagement. This is test data and not proof of client approval.
projects.objectives: Plan, design, develop, and coordinate a responsive website engagement.
projects.clientResponsibilities: Client will provide timely access, source content, brand assets, consolidated feedback, milestone approvals, and final proofing.
projects.assumptions: Final page count, content volume, integrations, and functionality will be confirmed through discovery, the project brief, sitemap, and wireframes.
projects.exclusions: Unlisted integrations, data migration, ongoing SEO programs, third-party subscriptions, stock assets, and out-of-scope content services are excluded unless selected.
projects.dependencies: Timely delivery of required materials, access, consolidated feedback, and approvals.
projects.timeline: Relative timing will be confirmed after kickoff and receipt of required materials.

lines.description: Responsive development, testing, and launch support.

optionalServices.name: Managed website hosting
optionalServices.description: Managed hosting, SSL, and backups only when specifically authorized.

optionalServices.description: Training beyond any explicitly included project allowance.

optionalServices.name: Copywriting
optionalServices.description: Client-facing copywriting or content organization services.

optionalServices.name: SEO add-on
optionalServices.description: Supplemental SEO strategy or ongoing program beyond foundational implementation.

terms.paymentTerms: Sample only — 50% advance with remaining authorized project charges due on receipt of invoice.
terms.estimateWording: Professional fees are estimates based on the hours and rates shown. Final charges will reflect actual work performed under the selected billing provisions; this estimate is not a fixed fee or an overall maximum.
terms.changeProcess: Work beyond the confirmed scope will be addressed through a written supplemental estimate or change order describing the revised scope, fees, and schedule effect before the additional work proceeds.
terms.includedRevisionRounds: Two consolidated rounds for wireframes and selected visual design deliverables.
